destination.name: Kiama
destination.tagline: A south-coast harbour town known for its blowhole and a 20 km coast walk.
destination.description: Kiama is a harbour town on the Illawarra coast, and its blowhole, with a lighthouse and viewing platforms beside it, is probably the town's most visited attraction. In a south-easterly swell the blowhole can spray water up to 30 m. The Kiama Coast Walk runs 20 km from the Minnamurra River through Kiama to Gerringong and can be walked in sections, and inland is Jamberoo Action Park. Gerringong, Shellharbour and Minnamurra Beach round out the coast.
whyVisit: Ride the slides at Jamberoo Action Park

goodToKnow.title: Blowhole conditions
goodToKnow.detail: The Kiama Blowhole is biggest in a south-easterly swell; the Little Blowhole, a little further south, works best in north-easterlies.

goodToKnow.title: Jamberoo opens on selected days
goodToKnow.detail: Jamberoo Action Park is open on selected days through the season, 10 am–5 pm, at about $84–94; check the calendar before you drive up.

goodToKnow.title: Whale season
goodToKnow.detail: The Gerringong whale-watching platform is used from May to November.

destination.bestTimeBlurb: {months} are the warm months for the beaches and Jamberoo Action Park, which opens only on selected days through its season.
